combat_baseline.attack_formula: 1d20 + relevant ability modifier + proficiency bonus if proficient.
combat_baseline.critical_hit: A natural 20 hits and doubles the attack’s damage dice.
combat_baseline.natural_1: A natural 1 on an attack roll misses.
combat_baseline.armor_class: Attack total must equal or exceed target AC.
combat_baseline.opportunity_attack: Reaction when a visible hostile leaves reach without Disengaging, teleporting, or being moved without its own movement.

actions.name: Attack
actions.resolution: Make one or more attacks allowed by the hero’s Game Level package.

actions.name: Use Power
actions.cost: Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction as listed
actions.resolution: Resolve the named hero power. Limited powers spend a use.

actions.name: Dash
actions.resolution: Gain extra movement equal to speed for this turn.

actions.name: Disengage
actions.resolution: Movement does not provoke opportunity attacks this turn.

actions.name: Dodge
actions.resolution: Until next turn, visible attacks have Disadvantage and Dexterity saves have Advantage while able to act.

actions.name: Help
actions.resolution: Give Advantage to one ally’s next relevant check or attack when meaningful assistance is possible.

actions.name: Hide
actions.resolution: Dexterity (Stealth) check against observers’ passive or active Perception.

actions.name: Ready
actions.resolution: Choose a perceivable trigger and a valid Action or movement response.

actions.name: Search
actions.resolution: Wisdom (Perception) to notice or Intelligence (Investigation) to inspect and deduce.

actions.name: Use Object
actions.resolution: Operate a door, lever, treasure item, barricade, light source, or environmental feature.

actions.name: Pick Lock
actions.resolution: Dexterity with Thieves’ Tools against lock DC; Legacy mode may use 1d10 and succeed on 7+.

actions.name: Disarm Trap
actions.resolution: Use the skill, tool, power, or counterplay stated by the trap.

actions.name: Force Obstacle
actions.resolution: Strength (Athletics) against the obstacle DC or attack its AC and HP.

actions.name: Room Theory
actions.resolution: While in a solution room, name one suspect, one weapon, and that room; resolve ordered private disproval.

actions.name: Final Accusation
actions.resolution: Submit exactly one suspect, weapon, and room to the authoritative server and apply the selected consequence.

actions.name: Stabilize or Restore
actions.cost: Action unless a power says otherwise
actions.resolution: Medicine, healer item, or power; restoration of death must occur within two rounds unless a specific rule overrides it.

actions.name: Trade
actions.resolution: Exchange permitted inventory or voluntarily reveal information; private cards follow lobby rules.

actions.name: Steal Opportunity
actions.resolution: Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or contested check; cannot falsify server inventory or hidden cards.

actions.name: Attack Rival
actions.cost: Normal attack cost; Work Separately only
actions.resolution: Resolve against the rival as a normal creature when PvP is enabled.

starting_weapon_attacks.name: Arrows
starting_weapon_attacks.damage: Determined by the bow or power that launches them
starting_weapon_attacks.notes: Korbin uses Fire Arrows with a crossbow-like ranged loadout; the sealed murder weapon card remains Arrows.

starting_weapon_attacks.name: Poison
starting_weapon_attacks.damage: Varies by dose; standard clue dose uses 2d6 poison on a failed Constitution save, half on success

starting_weapon_attacks.name: Headbutt
properties: Once per turn may attempt a 5-foot push after a hit

map_and_movement.accepted_grid_sizes: Any rectangular grid size; tokens, traps, doors, locks, auras, and ranges scale to grid.cell_px and grid.feet_per_square.

token_size_scaling.Tiny: 0.5 square visual / occupies as table allows
